what: Navigation app with 'anxious driver mode': longer routes that avoid difficult merges, left turns across traffic, high-stress driving situations.
why_us: Viral demand signal (7k+ likes) for accessibility/mental-health aware routing. Clear willingness to trade time for lower stress. Existing apps (Google/Apple Maps) lack this.
revenue: Potential $5-15/mo premium or freemium with paid calm-routes feature

what: Mute button / content filter for news feeds (HN, etc.): hide topics, paywalled links, AI slop, clickbait by keyword/domain/plain language rules.
why_us: #1 most recurring request on HN over 18 years (45 asks). Many partial builds exist but people keep asking — finishing/distribution gap. High willingness for better control.
revenue: Freemium or $5-10/mo for power users / power filter rules

what: Paid browser / Firefox fork with no ads, telemetry, Pocket, sponsored content, or forced AI, and stable UI.
why_us: Top-3 HN request with 68% willingness to pay. Privacy + ownership demand. Existing forks incomplete.

what: Postiz (open-source agentic social media scheduler) hit ~$372k-$400k MRR in Nov 2026, up from <$25k earlier in the year. Solo founder, open-source + hosted model.
why_us: Proof of massive growth in AI-agent friendly tools. Open-source distribution + agent usage (e.g. OpenClaw) drove virality. Shows high ARPU volume SaaS possible without VC.
engagement: Founder posts with hundreds of likes; verified via TrustMRR/Stripe

what: Private / local-first 'memory for everything': notes, bookmarks, pages, emails, files with context-aware resurfacing. Anti-cloud preference.
why_us: Recurring HN request (19 asks). 53% want local/private. Aligns with broader Reddit analysis of 7% explicit offline/privacy requests and subscription fatigue.
revenue: One-time or $10-20/mo local-first app (higher willingness than pure free tools)

what: Massive price-hike backlash on Harvest (time-tracking SaaS): customers reporting 5x-10x increases ($25→$160/mo, $6k→$30k/year) with short notice after acquisition.
why_us: Clear pain with existing paid users. Opportunity for fair-priced, transparent alternative or migration tool. High willingness to switch among long-term customers.
revenue: Capture churned users at 30-50% of old pricing; potential $10-50k/mo niche
engagement: Multiple detailed 1-star style complaints, high emotion

what: Analysis of 9,300+ Reddit 'I wish there was an app' posts: top volume in productivity, highest willingness-to-pay in education/self-improvement; strong anti-cloud / offline-first signal (~7%).
why_us: Data-backed demand map. Education shows strongest paid intent. Opportunity for privacy-first local tools or education micro-SaaS.
revenue: Median AI-built SaaS in category ~$5k/mo (from related reports); education niches higher
engagement: Article + related X analysis with 200+ likes
